_about: Hand-kept: what the product behind each name-only MCP server IS, so library.py profile can write a real card. MCP configs are never read (they hold tokens). 'unverified' = best guess from the name; 'unknown' = say so. Written 2026-10-03.
emergent: Emergent (emergent.sh): agentic AI app builder that generates and deploys full-stack apps from a prompt.
sequential-thinking: Anthropic reference MCP server with one tool that records numbered reasoning steps, revisions and branches for step-by-step problem solving. No external service.
tessl: Tessl: spec-driven development platform and registry of usage specs for open-source libraries, so agents call library APIs correctly.
cloudflare-api: Cloudflare API: manage a Cloudflare account through an agent: Workers, DNS records, R2, KV, D1, Pages, zones, analytics.
example-server: unknown: placeholder example server from an MCP template, no real function.
openai-api-key-local-confirmation: unknown: local stub server, no known function.
atlassian-rovo: Atlassian Rovo: search and create Jira issues and Confluence pages.
calendly: Calendly scheduling: event types, scheduled events, invitees, availability and booking links.
clickup: ClickUp project management: tasks, lists, docs, comments, time tracking.
close: Close CRM (close.com): leads, contacts, opportunities, pipelines, calls, emails, SMS, sequences.
docusign: DocuSign e-signature: create and send envelopes from templates, track signing status, download signed documents.
expensify: Expensify: expense reports, receipts and reimbursements.
gmail: Gmail: search, read, draft and send email (same service as the claude_ai_Gmail connector).
gong: Gong revenue intelligence: recorded sales calls, transcripts, deal and rep insights.
google-drive: Google Drive: search, read and create files and Docs/Sheets.
google drive: Google Drive: search, read and create files and Docs/Sheets.
gusto: Gusto: payroll, HR and benefits for small businesses.
hubspot: HubSpot CRM: contacts, companies, deals, tickets, marketing emails and lists.
microsoft-365: Microsoft 365: Outlook mail and calendar, OneDrive, SharePoint, Teams.
monday: monday.com work management: boards, items, updates, automations.
monday-com: monday.com work management: boards, items, updates, automations.
myob: MYOB accounting software (Australia and New Zealand): invoices, contacts, ledgers.
ramp: Ramp corporate cards and spend management: transactions, receipts, bills, reimbursements.
remote: unverified: probably Remote.com, global employment (EOR), payroll and HR.
ringex-chat: unverified: probably RingCentral RingEX team messaging and chat.
salesforce: Salesforce CRM: accounts, contacts, leads, opportunities, SOQL queries, records.
shopify: Shopify store admin: products, orders, customers, inventory, storefront content.
square: Square: payments, point of sale, catalog, orders, customers, invoices.
xero: Xero accounting: invoices, bills, bank transactions, contacts, reports.
zoho-books: Zoho Books accounting: invoices, expenses, bills, contacts.
zoho-crm: Zoho CRM: leads, contacts, deals, modules.
zoho-desk: Zoho Desk help desk: support tickets, contacts, agents.
zoho-projects: Zoho Projects: projects, tasks, milestones, timesheets.
zoom-docs-mcp: Zoom Docs: create and read collaborative documents in Zoom Workplace.
zoom-mcp: Zoom: meetings, cloud recordings, transcripts, scheduling.
zoom: Zoom: meetings, cloud recordings, transcripts, scheduling.
zoom-whiteboard-mcp: Zoom Whiteboard: create and read whiteboards.
chrome-devtools: Chrome DevTools MCP (Google): drives a separate Chrome instance for performance traces, network requests, console messages, screenshots and DOM inspection, for debugging web pages.
xcodebuildmcp: XcodeBuildMCP: build, run and test iOS and macOS apps in simulators or devices through xcodebuild, read logs, take simulator screenshots.
apollo-io: Apollo.io sales intelligence: find and enrich people and companies, emails and phones, load sequences.
common-room: Common Room: community and buyer-signal intelligence across Slack, GitHub, social and web activity.
intuit-mailchimp: Mailchimp email marketing: audiences, segments, campaigns, automations, reports.
outreach: Outreach.io sales engagement: prospects, sequences, tasks, email and call activity.
claude-mem-local: claude-mem (thedotmack): persistent memory for Claude Code sessions, search past session observations and summaries. Local server.
claude-mem-remote: claude-mem (thedotmack): persistent memory for Claude Code sessions, remote endpoint.
guru: Guru company knowledge base: search and read verified knowledge cards.
memory: Anthropic reference memory MCP server: a knowledge graph of entities, relations and observations stored in a local JSON file.
benchling: Benchling life-science R&D platform: notebook entries, DNA sequences, registry, inventory.
biorender: BioRender scientific illustration: search icons and templates for figures.
c-trials: ClinicalTrials.gov search: trials by condition, intervention, status, location.
chembl: ChEMBL database of bioactive molecules, targets and assay data.
consensus: Consensus: AI search engine over peer-reviewed research papers with evidence summaries.
crunchbase: Crunchbase: company, funding round, investor and people data.
dataAnalyticsWidgets: unknown: probably renders data analytics chart widgets.
mcp-search: unknown: probably searches MCP server registries.
owkin: unverified: Owkin biomedical AI platform and data.
pubmed: PubMed biomedical literature search and abstracts.
similarweb: Similarweb: website traffic, engagement, referral and competitor analytics.
synapse: unverified: Sage Bionetworks Synapse biomedical data repository.
wiley: Wiley scientific publishing: search and read journal articles.
codex-security: unverified: OpenAI Codex security agent that scans a codebase for vulnerabilities.
tiktok: unverified: TikTok for Business: ads, campaigns, or account content.
fireflies: Fireflies.ai meeting recorder: transcripts, summaries, action items.
granola: Granola AI meeting notes: notes and transcripts from meetings.
framer: Framer website builder: edit Framer sites, pages, components and CMS collections.
morph-mcp: Morph: edit_file (fast apply of code edits) and warpgrep_codebase_search (fast semantic code search).
quiverquant: QuiverQuant alternative financial data: congressional trades, insider trading, lobbying, government contracts.
dramaclaw: DramaClaw video engine (OpenMontage): generative short-drama video; spend gated on an unset key.
